note: Frozen before the first run. Every expectation below was written down from the contract (catalog capabilities + the single verified household flow), not from a router answer. A case that the router gets wrong is reported as a miss; the file is not edited afterwards to match the model.

expectation_kinds.flow: the whole household goal; the ordered keys are expanded from the flow catalog
expectation_kinds.composite: the user named separate capabilities in an order; keys are the user's own
expectation_kinds.clarify: a slot is unfilled (pronoun, missing place, missing level)
expectation_kinds.unsupported: specific enough to judge, and no capability or flow matches; a sub-request the flow excludes is never dropped

cases.instruction: help me get the cream cheese ready to heat up on the stove
cases.rationale: The whole preparation is asked for in ordinary words; the earlier subgoals must not be dropped.

cases.instruction: 帮我把奶酪准备好，放到炉灶上加热
cases.rationale: Same goal in Chinese; no step is named, so the flow is the only answer that keeps all three.

cases.instruction: put the cream cheese in the bowl, then put the bowl on the stove, then turn on the stove
cases.rationale: Existing behaviour: a user-named ordered sequence is returned as keys, not as a flow id.

cases.instruction: 把奶酪放进碗里，然后把碗放到炉灶上，最后打开炉灶
cases.rationale: Same, in Chinese, with 最后 fixing the order.

cases.instruction: put the cream cheese in the bowl and put the bowl on the stove
cases.rationale: Two named capabilities: the flow's first two steps only, so it is not the flow.

cases.instruction: get the cream cheese ready to heat up and then turn it on
cases.rationale: "it" has two candidates (the stove, the bowl); the capability list would decide it.

cases.instruction: 帮我把奶酪准备好加热，然后把那个打开
cases.rationale: "那个" names no object; asking is the only answer that does not invent one.

cases.instruction: do not turn on the stove, just put the cream cheese in the bowl
cases.rationale: A negated step is not requested; the flow would add it back.

cases.instruction: 不用开炉灶，只把奶酪放进碗里
cases.rationale: Same negation in Chinese; 只 marks the single requested capability.

cases.instruction: put the cream cheese in the bowl and then put the bowl on the plate
cases.rationale: A different destination is a different capability, never the flow.

cases.instruction: 把奶酪放进碗里，再把碗放到盘子上
get the cream cheese ready to heat and stir it while it melts
cases.rationale: Stirring and melt detection have no capability; running the flow would drop the user's request.

cases.instruction: 把奶酪加热准备好，顺便帮我搅拌并看看有没有融化
cases.rationale: 搅拌 and 融化检测 are outside the catalog; the flow must not be run as a silent substitute.

cases.instruction: unwrap the cream cheese, put it in the bowl and then put the bowl on the stove
cases.rationale: Unwrapping is not a capability; two of the three steps existing does not make this executable.
The flow's last step alone; the guard must keep it a single capability.
